name: The Name Over the Door
summary: Mordenkainen says the archmage who built the tower on the tarn never died: he moved downstairs, and he's waking.

stages.journal: Mordenkainen says Khazan, archmage of the old kings, who built the tower on Lake Baratok, never died. His sort move downstairs. Something under that tower is getting fat on being remembered.
objectives: Look under the hearth in Van Richten's Tower
stages.hint: Look under the hearthstone in Van Richten's Tower on Lake Baratok.

stages.journal: Under the hearthstone in Van Richten's Tower a stair goes down past the level of the lake, and from the bottom of it comes the sound of pages turning.
stages.hint: Take the stair under the hearthstone down beneath the tower.

stages.journal: Khazan is a lich, courteous and very old, in a study under his tower. He keeps a book of the name of everyone who has ever said his own at the door. Ours are in it.
objectives: Find out what keeps him in the world
stages.hint: Learn what keeps Khazan in the world, then deal with him in his study under the tower.

stages.journal: We drove Khazan out of his body, and it came apart into dust that went up through the ceiling, toward the tower and its door. While his name stands over that door, he'll only form again.
objectives: Unmake the name over the tower door
Then go back down and finish him
stages.hint: Unmake the name carved over the tower door, then go back down and finish Khazan.

stages.journal: The name over the tower door is gone. Under the island something let out a very long breath. Whatever forms again in the study below won't have a name to go back to.
objectives: Go down under the tower and finish Khazan
stages.hint: His name is gone from the door. Take the stair under the hearthstone back down to Khazan's study and finish him.

stages.journal: Khazan is gone for good. The book of names is blank, every page. Whatever he kept in his study is ours, and nobody has to say his name again.
